description: This file defines the 'Zone' class within the OpenCart admin module. It handles events related to zones, such as adding, editing, and deleting zones, and schedules tasks to update country information accordingly. The class extends a base Controller and interacts with models for tasks and localisation zones.

classes.name: Opencart\Admin\Controller\Event\Zone
classes.description: Controller class handling zone-related events in the admin panel, such as adding, editing, and deleting zones, and scheduling associated tasks.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Handles the 'add zone' event by scheduling a task to update country info based on the zone's country_id.

methods.name: editZone
methods.description: Handles the 'edit zone' event, updates country info tasks if the zone's country_id changes.

methods.name: deleteZone
methods.description: Handles the 'delete zone' event by scheduling a task to update country info after zone removal.
